# Armored Core 3 Archipelago

## What does randomization do to this game?
Mission unlocks and Parts are shuffled into the multiworld item pool. 

## What is the goal of Armored Core 3 when randomized?
- In Progressive Missions mode, complete Infiltrate Layered Hub. 
- In Mission-Sanity mode, complete a number of missions you can set between 1 and 49.
## What items and locations get shuffled?

Each mission completed is a location where you can find a check.
With Mailsanity turned on each piece of Mail read is a location.
With Shopsanity on, each part listing can be purchased for items separate from the ones you already own.

## Which items can be in another player's world?
Missions or Progressive Missions depending on your setting, as well as Parts and Credits as Filler.

## What does another world's item look like in Armored Core 3
Your item acquisitions take the form of having completed a mission or buying something from the shop.
You'll have to check the Armored Core 3 client to know the actual items.

## When the player receives an item, what happens?
The client will update the Mission list with what you have access to. If you are currently in the Mission list when sent a mission, you have to exit and re-enter for it to update.
Also, your inventory will be updated if you receive parts, you may need to renter the Assembly menu. 
## Notes and Limitations
- The mission menu restructuring, shop description and Optional Part name edit code requires a connection to the client and a connection to the server.

# Armored Core 3 Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Armored Core 3 apworld](https://github.com/Aleksandylmao/Armored-Core-3-PCSX2-Archipelago/releases) 
- [PCSX2 Emulator](https://pcsx2.net/downloads/)
- A legally-obtained Armored Core 3 ISO 
	- NTSC-U, SLUS-20435 
	
## Optional 
- [Analog Controls](https://github.com/VanLaser/analog-controls-for-armored-core-ps2?tab=readme-ov-file#qol-enhancements-analog-controls-for-armored-core-ps2-series-ac2-ac2-another-age-ac3-ac-silent-line)

## Installing the World
1. Download `armoredcore3.apworld` from the [releases](https://github.com/Aleksandylmao/Armored-Core-3-PCSX2-Archipelago/releases) page.
2. Double-click it, drag it onto `ArchipelagoLauncher.exe` or put it in your Archipelago/lib/worlds folder.

## Generating
- To generate a game, follow [the official instructions.](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en#generating-a-game)

## Configuring PCSX2
By default, PINE features are disabled in PCSX2. Please follow these steps to enable it: 

1. In PCSX2: **Tools -> Show Advanced Settings**.
2. **System -> Settings -> Advanced -> PINE Settings**: check **Enable**,
   Slot **28011**.   

## Connecting

1. Open the **Armored Core 3 Client** from the Archipelago launcher.
2. It will try to auto-detect PCSX2 over PINE.
3. To connect the client to the server, enter your room's address and port (e.g. archipelago.gg:38281) into the top text field of the client and click Connect.
4. Open PCSX2 and launch Armored Core 3.
5. After the client has connected to both PCSX2 and the Archipelago server, you can start playing!

You should now be able to receive and send items. It is possible to make progress offline if you're already loaded into a mission when you drop your connection, but the mission menu restructuring code requires a connection to the Armored Core 3 Client. If the connection drops while you are in the Shop and buy an Item it will not send and you will need to buy it again. 

Ensure that you create a brand new save file each time you start a fresh Archipelago world. 
If you take a break and come back to the game, ensure you resume from the same save file you have been using.

readme.text:
# Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) Archipelago

Armored Core 3 is a 2002 third-person shooter video game developed by FromSoftware for the PlayStation 2.
It is the sixth entry in the Armored Core series.

Available to download in the [releases](https://github.com/Aleksandylmao/Armored-Core-3-PCSX2-Archipelago/releases)  section!

## [Setup Guide](docs/setup_en.md)
## [Randomizer Info](docs/en_Armored%20Core%203.md)
[Mail Logic](docs/mail.md)
-----
### Prerequisites:
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Armored Core 3 APWorld](https://github.com/Aleksandylmao/Armored-Core-3-PCSX2-Archipelago/releases) 
- [PCSX2 Emulator](https://pcsx2.net/downloads/)
- A legally-obtained Armored Core 3 ISO 
	- NTSC-U, SLUS-20435 

  
Acknowledgements
---
Thank you to these projects for helping me make this Archipelago Implementation possible:
- The Archipelago Core Team and Contributors
- evilwb's [pypine](https://github.com/evilwb/pypine)
- [thatbard's](https://retroachievements.org/user/thatbard) [Armored Core 3 RetroAchievements](https://retroachievements.org/game/3308) for providing many Memory Addresses
- [Armored Core APWorld](https://github.com/JustinMarshall98/Armored-Core-PSX-Archipelago/releases)  which got me to play the older games again and inspired me to make this APWorld 

AI Disclaimer
---
- Was AI used in any capacity?
- - Yes
- If so, what tools were used?
- - Claude and ChatGPT 
- What was the purpose of your use of these tools?
- - Mainly for code reviews, Ai looks at my code informs me of bugs that I missed, what would be a better design, etc. I always take its feedback with a grain of salt.    
- - Sometimes technical questions, since I'm still new to Python and APWorld development 
- - One minor bug fixes. e.g. in the Shops certain symbols (e.g. `<` and `>`) could cause crashes, I identified it and AI wrote the function which looked good to me.
- - At the beginning I tried to use it to help me find memory addresses, but it didn't help at all. In the end it was faster to learn a bit of assembly myself.
- How extensively were the tools used? 
- - I let AI review my code regularly. Bug fixing not much. Asking question at the beginning pretty often, but less and less over time. 
- How much human review was done?
- - All the code was reviewed and written by me. If somebody else wants to review my code feel free to do so. 

Support
---
Have suggestions, comments or issues?
Please get in touch in the Armored Core 3 thread of the custom-games in the official Archipelago Discord Server.

---
Pls give the other Armored Core APWorlds also a try.
- [Armored Core](https://github.com/JustinMarshall98/Armored-Core-PSX-Archipelago/releases)
- [Armored Core 6](https://github.com/DeltaSilver/Armored-Core-6-Archipelago/releases)

notes.text:
# v0.3.0 - Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) APWorld

New in this version
---
* **Mailsanity:** Adds an option to turn mails into locations that must be checked throughout the game.
  * **None (Default):** Mails are not included as locations.
  * **Standard:** All mails except challenges become locations.
  * **Include Challenges:** In addition to standard mails, challenge-related mails become locations. These include OP-Intensify mails, Bonus Missions, and special mission objectives (e.g. destroying the Naire Bridge or the two traveling monorails).
   * **Mail Logic:** <https://github.com/Aleksandylmao/Armored-Core-3-PCSX2-Archipelago/blob/master/docs/mail.md>
## Bug Fixes

* Fixed a bug that you buy an item in the shop, but the check doesn't get sent out.
* Fixed a bug that the Optional Part Assembly menu shows the Shop Item names instead of the normal Names. 
* Improved the performance of the interface in the client that connects with the PCSX2 Emulator. 

## Known Issues
* Sometimes, missions don't load correctly into the menu. Simply exit the menu and open it again.
